description: This file defines the `ExecAllowlistMatcher` enum which contains static methods for matching executable patterns against command resolutions, primarily used to determine if a command is allowed based on an allowlist. It includes pattern validation, normalization, and regex-based matching functions.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a single execution resolution against a list of allowlist entries to find a matching entry, returning the allowed entry if any.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Matches multiple command resolutions against the allowlist entries to retrieve all matching entries.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given target path matches a pattern, supporting wildcards and tilde expansion.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes path strings by replacing backslashes with slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Converts a simplified glob pattern into a NSRegularExpression object for matching paths.
